omittedDeclarations.reason: One exact overload is declared but has no implementation in the locked upstream repository; this is an upstream library limitation, not a BGCS parsing or lowering limitation.

upstreamLimitations.diagnosticEvidence: Complete locked source search finds only the declaration.
